newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar ends weaker, May holds above low.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar ends weaker, May holds above low.

text.p: LIFFE sugar futures ended weaker on Wednesday evening but May managed to stay above its low after being hit by pre-EU tender hedging, traders said.
The most active May contact finished 90 cents softer at $308.20 per tonne, after trading between $307.60 and $309.30.
August ended $2.00 weaker at its low of $306.40 after earlier touching a high of $308.50.
Traders had been watching the New York market to see if May was able to break above 11 cents/lb level, they said.
Volume on LIFFE was 2,282 lots with 1,123 lots in May.
In Paris, May ended unchanged at $308.00 and August $1.30 weaker at $307.00.
